steps.name: install-closed-loop-runner
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 4c3105720cf2295d934849b84b41713c67836c60; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8b/run_climate_v6_closed_loop.py > tools/ml/run_climate_v6_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/run_climate_v6_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/run_climate_v6_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_benchmark.py -q; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: full-held-out-closed-loop-benchmark
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; CLIMATE_BENCHMARK_WORKERS=6 PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_climate_v6_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, math
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('build/climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['config']['workers'] == 6
assert d['config']['scenarios_per_family'] == 2
assert d['config']['steps_per_scenario'] == 60
assert set(d['aggregate']) == {'rule','teacher','ml'}
assert len(d['families']) == 13
assert len(d['episodes']) == 78
assert d['model']['candidate_name'] == 'adam_huber'
assert d['model']['parameter_count'] == 2502
for name, metrics in d['aggregate'].items():
    assert metrics['steps'] == 1560, (name, metrics['steps'])
    for key in ('tracking_cost','outside_deadband_fraction','temperature_mae_c','rh_mae_pct','vpd_mae_kpa','co2_mae_ppm','switching_per_step','safety_intervention_fraction','hard_limit_violation_fraction'):
        assert math.isfinite(float(metrics[key])), (name,key)
Path('reports/ml').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273.json').write_text(p.read_text())
print('CLOSED_LOOP_RESULT_VALIDATION=PASS')
print('CLOSED_LOOP_ACCEPTED=', d['verdict']['accepted'])
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/run_climate_v6_closed_loop.py; git diff --check; git status --short

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-benchmark
